column1: # No published build shipped the plugin .cfg, in a ZIP or as a launcher-manifest.json seed (every
# seed is BepInEx/config/BepInEx.cfg), so the inputs are what each build writes at its first start.
# A first-run file is the .cfg that build's own ValheimHeadTracking.dll and CameraUnlock.Core.Unity.BepInEx.dll,
# taken from its release installer ZIP, write when its HeadTrackingConfig.Initialize runs on a
# ConfigFile at a path with no file and the plugin's own BepInPlugin metadata, as BaseUnityPlugin
# builds it: the published binaries run once under the BepInEx above, with the Unity stubs of pixi
# run setup. v0.1.0 to v0.2.0 were built against the game's own assemblies and name KeyCode in
# UnityEngine.CoreModule, so their run adds a forwarder from that name to the stubs' types. The
# "Acceptable values" comment lines list the stubs' KeyCode members, not the game's; no reader reads
# a comment line. v0.1.0, v0.1.1 and v0.1.2 ship the same DLL, whose metadata says 1.0.5, and write
# the same bytes, so one file stands for the three.
